Change c0264. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. XIV.

Context before (unchanged): The prospect of marrying a Christian, and remaining in a country where women were allowed to take a rank in society, was enchanting to her.

1818 text: "The day for the execution of the Turk was fixed; but, on the night previous to it, he had quitted prison, and before morning was distant many leagues from Paris.

1831 text: "The day for the execution of the Turk was fixed; but, on the night previous to it, he quitted his prison, and before morning was distant many leagues from Paris.

Diff: " The day for the execution of the Turk was fixed; but, on the night previous to it, he [-had-] quitted {+his+} prison, and before morning was distant many leagues from Paris.

Context after (unchanged): Felix had procured passports in the name of his father, sister, and himself.

result.rationale: Only the auxiliary 'had' is dropped and 'his' inserted before 'prison' ("he had quitted prison" becomes "he quitted his prison"). Events and meaning are unchanged; this is a minor syntactic and stylistic adjustment.
